requirement: Look up the ordinary short-stay nationality baseline in pinned partial reference data. This is not a final visa-requirement determination.
implementation_notes: Use classifyBaseline(model, rule, referenceData), separate from compliance PASS/FAIL evaluation. No final visa entitlement is determined.

For this supported ordinary-national passport context passport.issuing_country supplies the normalized nationality lookup key. Non-ordinary documents are routed to review; issuer is not generalized into nationality for refugee or other special travel documents.

The official/evidence layer uses ISO-style codes; applicant normalization currently trims supplied tokens without converting country aliases. The community layer uses display names. The adapter must supply an ISO code; the classifier never converts display names or guesses nationality.

Applicant conditions [] explicitly means no declared special conditions; null means unknown, not ordinary. Only configured ordinary tokens are permitted without review. Unrecognized tokens return UNKNOWN rather than being discarded.

Special-condition tokens are routing labels only, not findings that an exemption applies. Non-ordinary document types always require separate review. Residence is not a lookup key or exemption condition.
Pinned source/evidence revisions remain NEEDS_REVIEW. The supplied consolidation date labels reference data only; effective dates remain unknown and no release is created.
